verdict.rationale: Bento's broadcasts API docs say developers can use the API to create campaigns and schedule approved sends with explicit audience rules. They document audience parameters such as exclusive_tags. HTTP Basic authentication conventions, an endpoint reference browser and a Postman collection support a fully programmatic, dashboard-free workflow. Missing for 10: documented detail of the scheduling parameters themselves (send-at time, timezone), and independent or hands-on corroboration that create-and-schedule works end to end via the API.
